note:
R31 — PS4 GNF header census over every `.gnf` of the extracted PS4 trees (headers + file sizes only; read-only): the T# fields as
Studio's `tdb-rx2::gnf` splits them (width / height / data format / number format / base+last level / tiling index / type / pitch / depth)
plus the GNF header words (contentsSize, version, count, alignment, streamSize), dword 7 and the 16 bytes after the T#, tested against the
size rules a resize writer needs: `streamSize == file size`, `pitch == width - 1`, `d7 == data bytes`, and `data bytes == sum over mip
levels of the micro-tiled level size` (tiling 13: each level padded to whole 8x8-block micro tiles; hypothesis tested per file).
Usage: python r31_gnf_header_census.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,nhl15] [--max N]
